notes.title: Update 1.0.4
notes.content:
A big game design update aimed at improving the responsiveness of the game and new ways of progression

A new money system has been added to the game, on which various mechanics are tied. In particular, now getting some types of equipment now requires money.

notes.title: Update 1.0.3
notes.content:
A small update, the main purpose of which is to improve the player's navigation through the main plot.

[list]
[*] Added a pointer (arrow) to the current target. It is visible when the inventory is open
[*] The balance of the mechanical dungeon has been changed
[*] Fixed some minor bugs
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.2
notes.content:
This update is designed to fix some errors that were missed earlier.

[list]
[*] Fixed a softlock after loading a save made after restarting the game.
[*] Fixed incorrect display of end credits
[*] Shock wave damage has been reduced
[/list]

Saving game settings (Character, difficulty and language) has also been added. There is no longer a need to re-select them when starting a new game

notes.title: Update from December 11, 2021
notes.content:
This small update is designed to fix some bugs found, including:
-Fixed the loss of rare items from light opponents
-Changed the location of some secrets
-Increased invulnerability frames after taking damage


Also added full support for the Ukrainian language
